description: This file contains utility functions for lowering exported PyTorch models to an AOTInductor backend, including flattening/unflattening modules, compiling with AOTI, and packaging for the NativeRT deployment.

classes.name: FlattenedModule
classes.description: A torch.nn.Module subclass that wraps an original module and provides input/output flattening/unflattening to facilitate model lowering.

methods.name: ExportedProgram get_new_ep_with_flat_inputs_outputs(ep: ExportedProgram)
methods.description: Creates a new exported program with flattened inputs and outputs by wrapping the original module in a FlattenedModule.

methods.name: tuple[ExportedProgram,AOTI_FILES] lower_exported_program( exported_program: ExportedProgram, model_name: str, backend_id: str )
methods.description: Lowers an exported program to an AOTInductor delegate, producing a delegate exported program and its associated AOTI files.

methods.name: None package_nativert_with_aoti_delegate( f: FileLike, model_name: str, backend_id: str, original_ep: ExportedProgram, delegate_ep: ExportedProgram, delegate_files: AOTI_FILES, )
methods.description: Packages the original and delegate exported programs into a pt2 archive file suitable for use with NativeRT with AOTI Delegate.
